div.div: إِعْظَامَةٌ and ↓ عِظَامَةٌ and ↓ عُظَّامَةٌ and ↓ عُظْمَةٌ (S, K, TA) [the last written in one of my copies of the S عُظُمَّة] and ↓ عَظِيمَةٌ (TA) [and ↓ عَظَمَةٌ (Freytag from the Deewán of Jereer)] A thing like a pillow (Fr, S) &c., (Fr,) or a garment, or piece of cloth, (K,) with which a woman makes her posteriors [to appear] large. (Fr, S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
